subject: Re: Problem with rhbase --- thrift server error

messages.author: 1eafd5d24fb29c12
messages.subject: Re: Problem with rhbase --- thrift server error
parts:
rhbase uses TBufferedTransport, which is the default for thrift.  When you specify the "-hsha" or "-nonblocking" command line parameters for thrift, it uses the TFramedTransport.  So, if you remove the -hsha parameter it should work.  We could look to supporting both buffered transport and framed transport.  What is the reason you are using the THsHaServer?

On Friday, June 29, 2012 5:14:26 AM UTC-7, Souvik Banerjee wrote:
Hi,

I was trying to use rhbase package to read from hbase from R.
I am using R 2.15.0 and rhbase_1.0.4.tar.gz.
I have installed the package and downloaded hbase-0.94.0.
Also completed all the prerequisite for the thrift server installation.
Downloaded the thrift-0.8.0.tar.gz and compiled thrift without ruby support.
Then I installed the thrift and started the server as follows.

CD to the hbase directory.
$ cd hbase-0.94.0/
$ ./bin/hbase thrift -hsha start

The server is running with the following print in the console
12/06/29 07:38:38 DEBUG thrift.ThriftServerRunner: Using binary protocol
12/06/29 07:38:38 DEBUG thrift.ThriftServerRunner: Using framed transport
12/06/29 07:38:38 INFO thrift.ThriftServerRunner: starting HBase THsHaServer server on 9090

Then I am trying to connect from the R.

>library("rhbase")
>hb.init(host="x.y.z.p", port=9090)
>hb.list.tables()
Thrift: Fri Jun 29 08:08:59 2012 TSocket::read() recv() <Host: x.y.z.p Port
: 9090>Connection reset by peer
Error in hb.list.tables() : rhbase:: ECONNRESET

As you can see that I am getting error.
In the thrift server console I am getting the folowing message

12/06/29 08:08:59 ERROR server.THsHaServer: Read an invalid frame size of -2147418111. Are you using TFramedTransport on the client side?

The same problem occurs even if I start the server in nonblocking mode.

Any help in this regard is highly appreciated.

Thanking you.

Souvik.

messages.author: da2ca011efc9d511
messages.subject: Re: Problem with rhbase --- thrift server error
parts:
Thanks for your reply.
There is no specific reason for using THsHaServer or nonblocking one.

There is no default with the HBase. I have to specify at least one of the options supported by the server.
If I run
$./bin/hbase thrift start

Then the server is not starting and the error message is
Exception in thread "main" java.lang.AssertionError: Exactly one option out of [-hsha, -nonblocking, -threadpool, -threadedselector] has to be specified

Out of these options I tried with -hsha and -nonblocking only because I have to specify one.
With either of the options I am getting the same error message.
Any help in this regard is highly appreciated.
